costs.additive_rule: Only sum the same timer across disjoint events/workers. Do not sum different scopes into a total; campaign wall is the outer measured total.

timer_scope_notes.activation_s: Pre-update checkpoint publication and validation inside serving/event wall; excludes final-evaluation activations.
timer_scope_notes.adaptation_ready_wall_s: Nested in campaign wall: initialization, serving backend load, eight adaptation events and their checks.
timer_scope_notes.backend_loading_s: One serving-backend load within campaign/adaptation wall.
timer_scope_notes.campaign_wall_s: Outer campaign wall, including cleanup; excludes separate preflight/postflight and report built after this timer.
timer_scope_notes.checkpoint_save_s: Worker subcomponent; export_s in trainer RESULT is deferred zero, not the later materialized-export cost.
timer_scope_notes.compiler_timers: Per-name sums over sequential workers; names can nest, and are already inside native training time. Never sum across timer names.
timer_scope_notes.construction_and_restore_s: Sum scope of construction_s and restore_s; do not add all three.
timer_scope_notes.descriptor_s: Shared CPU descriptor construction within event wall.
timer_scope_notes.evaluation_wall_s: Final capture-OFF evaluation scope, including its publication, checks and barriers; inside campaign wall.
timer_scope_notes.event_wall_s: Disjoint sequential event scopes; each includes pre-update serving, preparation, selection, training workers, maintenance, exports and checks.
timer_scope_notes.export_and_verify_s: Post-eviction native export, load and exact-weight verification, outside training workers but inside event/campaign wall.
timer_scope_notes.feature_admission_io_and_validation_s: Worker subcomponent before native pass loops.
timer_scope_notes.feature_persistence_s: Prepared-packet save inside event wall, not all native capture I/O.
timer_scope_notes.initialization_s: Sum of three initialization workers; separate process-wall scopes include startup.
timer_scope_notes.memory_maintenance_s: Reservoir commit/eviction and associated retirement within event wall.
timer_scope_notes.process_wall_s: Outer subprocess wall including startup and worker wall; never add to worker wall.
timer_scope_notes.resource_check_s: Disk/cache scan sum inside event/evaluation/campaign scopes; RESOURCE_CHECKS.jsonl is canonical, STATUS copies are not additional samples.
timer_scope_notes.selection_s: Shared CPU pass selection within event wall.
timer_scope_notes.teacher_preparation_s: Shared K feedback preparation includes native/terminal loading, binding checks, concatenation and terminal teacher forward; not isolated GPU compute or separately attributable to each arm.
timer_scope_notes.total_loop_s: Includes training_s and input_load_and_loop_bookkeeping_s; do not add loop total to its children.
timer_scope_notes.training_s: Native per-response timer sums, including forward/backward/optimizer and observations; excludes input file loading.
timer_scope_notes.worker_wall_s: Inside event wall: construction/restore, feature admission, native loops, checkpoint commit, validation, state hashing and cleanup; excludes Python process startup.

plan.lifecycle: One shared initial; retire preceding serving exports after all serving checks; defer exports until successor state validation and reservoir eviction.

native_feature_tensor.lost_capability: Original native capture tensor removed; compact conditioning evidence survives. Prepared supervision remains only while retained in reservoir.

preceding_export.lost_capability: This intermediate serving-weight file is unavailable; compact serving checks/configuration remain.

predecessor_full_state.lost_capability: Direct exact resume from this intermediate full model/Adam/RNG boundary is lost; compact validation survives. Immediate successors can also be retired; later retained boundaries are listed separately.

prepared_packet.lost_capability: Exact evicted supervision tensor is unavailable for direct replay. Descriptor, source identity and compact membership/validation receipts survive.

terminal_feature_tensor.lost_capability: Separate terminal teacher tensor removed; compact evidence survives. Prepared supervision remains only while retained in reservoir.

notes: Retired tensors are deleted, not archived.
Receipt sizes count removed directory entries. Allocated-byte sums are nominal and are not measured reclaimed space: hardlinks and open references may retain blocks.
No inode-only deduplication: receipts lack filesystem device IDs; inode reuse can also occur.
Retained evidence means production validated these artifacts and no matching retirement is recorded. Compact-only retrieval does not rehash their bulk bytes or prove current remote presence.
trainer/training_state.pt is a producer-maintained latest hardlink alias; it is not an additional independently retained payload.
